role: Pure policy for the strap HR feed: classifies it waiting/settingUp/live/stalled from timestamps and decides none/resubscribe/resetLink, plus the resubscribe backoff schedule.
types: StrapFeedHealth.Status: enum — UI feed status (stored in PolarManager.feedStatus)
StrapFeedHealth.Inputs: struct — snapshot of clock, link and feed timestamps

units.does: From a snapshot decides the feed Status and Action: not linked → waitingForStrap; a sample within 15 s → live; before the stall start → settingUp; else stalled with stalledAction.

branches.effect: false: status settingUp if no sample yet else live (the live arm is unreachable: with a sample, stall start = last+15 s and line 76 already returned for now <= last+15 s); true: stalled + stalledAction
true: settingUp; false: live (unreachable, see line 80)

flags.text: The `.live` arm of the ternary at line 81 cannot be taken: when lastSampleAt is set, stallStart is last+15 s, and any now <= last+15 s already returned .live at line 76, so the guard at line 80 always passes.

units.does: Stall start: last sample + 15 s; else readiness settle + 45 s; else link time + 90 s.

branches.effect: true: settled+45 s; false: linkedAt+90 s

units.does: Action for a stalled feed: resubscribe unless one already happened during this stall; then only in a session and after 30 s does it return resetLink, unless a link reset happened within 180 s; otherwise none.

branches.cond: a resubscribe happened at/after the stall start
sessionActive and >= 30 s since the resubscribe
branches.effect: false: .none (outside a session a stalled feed is resubscribed once per stall and then left alone); true: continue

units.does: Backoff for re-opening the subscription: [1,2,3,5] s indexed by failures clamped to 0...3.
